> me (to me) + dices (you tell). Object pronoun goes before conjugated verb.

te digo.back:

> le (to him/her) + digo (I tell). Object pronoun goes before conjugated verb.

nos dice.back:

> nos (to us) + dice (he/she tells). Object pronoun goes before conjugated verb.

les digo.back:

*Les digo a mis amigos que vengan.*

> les (to them) + digo (I tell). Object pronoun goes before conjugated verb.

me dicen.back:
they tell me

*Me dicen que todo está bien.*

> me (to me) + dicen (they tell). Object pronoun goes before conjugated verb.

dime.back:
tell me

*Dime qué pasó.*

> di (tell, tú command) + me (to me). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

dile.back:
tell him/her

*Dile que venga mañana.*

> di (tell, tú command) + le (to him/her). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

dinos.back:
tell us

*Dinos la historia completa.*

> di (tell, tú command) + nos (to us). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

diles.back:
tell them

*Diles que no se preocupen.*

> di (tell, tú command) + les (to them). Pronoun attaches to end of affirmative commands.

decirme.back:
to tell me

*¿Puedes decirme dónde está?*

> decir (to tell) + me (to me). Pronoun attaches to end of infinitives.

decirte.back:
to tell you

*Quiero decirte algo importante.*

> decir (to tell) + te (to you). Pronoun attaches to end of infinitives.

escúchame.back:
listen to me

*Escúchame, esto es serio.*

> escucha (listen, tú command) + me (to me). Same pattern works with any verb.

ayúdame.back:
help me

*Ayúdame con la tarea, por favor.*

> ayuda (help, tú command) + me (to me). Same pattern works with any verb.

no me digas.back:
don't tell me

*No me digas mentiras.*

> Negative commands flip the pronoun back to before the verb. Compare: dime (tell me) vs no me digas (don't tell me).

no le digas.back:
don't tell him/her

*No le digas nada a tu hermano.*

> Negative commands flip the pronoun back to before the verb. Compare: dile (tell him/her) vs no le digas (don't tell him/her).

no me escuches.back:
don't listen to me

*No me escuches, estoy bromeando.*

> Negative commands flip the pronoun back to before the verb. Compare: escúchame (listen to me) vs no me escuches (don't listen to me).

no nos digas.back:
don't tell us

*No nos digas el final de la película.*

> Negative commands flip the pronoun back to before the verb. Compare: dinos (tell us) vs no nos digas (don't tell us).

diciéndome.back:
telling me

*Sigue diciéndome la historia.*

> diciendo (telling, gerund) + me (to me). Pronoun attaches to end of gerunds, same as commands and infinitives.

diciéndote.back:
telling you

*Estoy diciéndote la verdad.*

> diciendo (telling, gerund) + te (to you). Pronoun attaches to end of gerunds, same as commands and infinitives.
